subject: Private Upgrade: maintenance ownership & rollback roster
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acmehealth.com>, Ops-SRE <Ops-SRE@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private upgrade proposal — ownership & maintenance roster

Hi Alice / Acme SRE team,

Following our call this morning, attached is a proposed maintenance ownership roster and a high-level orchestration plan for the 3.4.1 -> 3.5.0 Private runtime upgrade for your VPC deployment. Key points:

- We will keep your current model binaries pinned to 3.4.1 during the canary period; traffic split will be 95/5 (stable/canary).
- Primary maintenance window suggested: Sat 2027-06-05 02:00–06:00 PT (4 hours) — low traffic observed.
- If canary shows performance regressions >5% token-latency or any functional errors, automatic rollback to the pinned 3.4.1 image will trigger.

Attached: maintenance_matrix.xlsx (ownership per step), rollback_runbook.pdf (playbook). Can you confirm the maintenance window and on-call roster on your side?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: maintenance_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: rollback_runbook.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ops-SRE <Ops-SRE@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private upgrade proposal — ownership & maintenance roster

Marissa — thanks for the plan and the attachments. A few quick confirmations from Acme:

- Window 2027-06-05 02:00–06:00 PT works for us.
- Our primary on-call will be me (Alice) plus SRE backup Jamie Ortega. I attached our internal change ticket number CHG-9012.
- Important: any change that requires data-plane key rotation needs prior approval from our Security Ops (we do not expect that for this release).

We’ll review the matrix and flag any conflicts by EOD Monday. Please include the exact rollback CLI commands in the runbook.

—Alice
Alice Jones, Director, Platform Ops
Acme Health Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private upgrade proposal — ownership & maintenance roster

Looping internal owners on the technical runbook and gating. Notes from the runtime team:

- Canary config: 1 rack (8 GPUs), seq_len 1024, synthetic traffic + 5% real traffic from Acme to validate KV cache behavior.
- Version pinning: operator will set imageTag: redwood-runtime:3.4.1-pinned for stable nodes; canary uses redwood-runtime:3.5.0-canary.
- Rollback primitives: kube rollout undo + image rollback script (included in rollback_runbook.pdf). We will also snapshot model KV cache metadata to S3 path s3://acme-priv-backups/kvmeta/20270524/ before canary start.

Action items for the upgrade playbook sheet:
1) Pre-checks (network ACLs, health probes) — owner: lauren_bishop
2) Canary deploy + smoke tests — owner: karthik_iyer
3) Scale to blue/green and promote — owner: vivek_kulkarni
4) Post-cut validation and cost telemetry capture — owner: karthik_iyer

I attached a compact ownership column to maintenance_matrix.xlsx; please confirm owners and cross-check with Acme’s SRE.

-Karthik
Principal Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acmehealth.com>, Ops-SRE <Ops-SRE@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private upgrade proposal — ownership & maintenance roster

Alice — thanks, and appreciated the CHG ref. Acme confirmed the window and the on-call roster; no key rotation expected. A few clarifications for Acme SREs:

- We will expose a read-only probe at /health/upgrade-check that returns runtime version and current KV cache size. Please keep the host firewall open for the Redwood probe IPs listed in the Drive doc.
- During the 95/5 canary we’ll stream token-latency metrics to the shared metrics endpoint; if 95th-percentile latency regresses >5% we’ll abort and trigger rollback.
- Tentative SLA exception for up to 30 minutes of elevated latency during index warm-up; documented in the runbook.

Next step: Acme to ACK maintenance_matrix.xlsx by EOD today so we can lock the schedule and issue the CHG.

Regards,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private upgrade proposal — ownership & maintenance roster

Internal checklist addendum before we finalize:

- Confirm automated rollback smoke-tests run in <10 minutes and clear exit codes. Owner: karthik_iyer
- Confirm runbook contains the manual rollback sequence for air-gapped customers (tarball restore + KV metadata reapply). Owner: lauren_bishop
- Confirm Doc link to third-party kernel/driver compatibility matrix is embedded. Owner: vivek_kulkarni
- Change freeze: no customer-facing feature merges 72 hours prior to window. Owner: PM on call (Marissa to coordinate).

I’ll update rollback_runbook.pdf with the manual air-gapped steps and publish a small run-through doc for the on-call rotation. If no objections, I’ll push the final versions to the Drive folder and ping Acme for last ACK.

—Vivek
Director, Infrastructure & Reliability
Redwood Inference
